question: By whom, on opposing sides of the ten-headed one, is the Goddess revered?
premises: The Goddess is worshipped by the ten-headed one and by Hara.
The Goddess is adored by the enemy of the ten-headed one.
inference: The Goddess receives reverence from both the ten-headed one and his adversary.
uncertainties: The ten-headed one and his enemy are not explicitly named in this verse.
plain_english: She is worshipped by the ten-headed one and by Hara, and adored by the enemy of the ten-headed one.
